meta.name: hyperframes-registry
meta.description: Install, discover, and wire registry blocks and components into HyperFrames compositions. Use when running hyperframes add or hyperframes catalog, installing one item or every block matching a tag, wiring an installed item into index.html, or working with hyperframes.json. Covers discovery, install locations, block sub-composition wiring, component snippet merging, and authoring a new block or component to contribute upstream (idea → scaffold → validate → PR).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 安装、发现并接入 HyperFrames 组件
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在用 HyperFrames 开发,需要装组件或开发新组件
copy.tagline_en: Install, discover, and wire HyperFrames components
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build with HyperFrames and need component management or authoring

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你安装和搜索注册表里的 blocks 和 components，指导你把它们接入项目，并处理 hyperframes.json 配置。
howto.when: 当你要求安装或搜索注册表项目、把已安装的块或组件接入项目，或处理 hyperframes.json 时触发。

say.text: 帮我安装 data-chart 这个 block。
say.note: 会下载并告知写入的文件和需要粘贴的片段。

say.text: 搜索能让标题逐行显现的块。
say.note: 会用 catalog 查询并列出匹配项目。

say.text: 帮我把 grain-overlay 组件接进我的 index.html。
say.note: 会指导你粘贴 HTML 和样式代码。

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to run hyperframes commands to install, discover, and wire registry blocks and components into HyperFrames compositions, and to handle hyperframes.json configuration.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to install or search registry items, wire an installed block or component into your project, or work with hyperframes.json.

say_en.text: Install the data-chart block into my project.
say_en.note: Downloads it and shows files written plus a snippet to paste.

say_en.text: Search for blocks that reveal a headline one line at a time.
say_en.note: Runs a catalog query and lists matching items.

say_en.text: Wire the grain-overlay component into my index.html.
say_en.note: Steps you through pasting its HTML and styles.
